name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Implementation Manager | Concurrent Launches, Project Management & Integrations
summary: Implementation manager who runs multiple concurrent launches from kickoff to steady state as the customer's primary point of contact. At Wix I launched 25+ clients a month with up to ~25 in flight, at 110% of implementation targets. I diagnose integration issues myself (webhooks, REST APIs, JSON payloads) and build the plans, templates, and handoffs that keep the next launch on schedule.

experience.title: Implementation Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Lead end-to-end implementations as the client's primary contact from kickoff to go-live, translating business requirements into system configuration and workflows, then training owners and staff.
Diagnose and resolve integration issues in production workflows (Zapier, Make, n8n, GoHighLevel), working directly in webhooks, REST API calls, JSON payloads, and OAuth/API-key credentials.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping project records auditable across concurrent engagements.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and trained 15-20 reseller partners across health, home services, and retail, including agencies focused on healthcare clients, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Guided customers through complex technical setup of reputation and marketing automation tools.
Fed structured, high-priority customer feedback to Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors across teams.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Implemented and launched 25+ clients per month with up to ~25 concurrent onboardings, holding 110% of implementation targets and delivering launches on schedule.
Led multiple onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists as primary strategic contact, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Drove process improvements for a new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to profitable.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute.
Guided onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations alongside implementation teams, building relationships with C-suite executives.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
